problem.text: Copied auxiliary filenames previously appeared immediately after the excluded-file warning, using identical bullet formatting. This could make included files look excluded.

reasoning.text: The patch moves the existing print-and-copy loop ahead of the ignored-file warning. It separates the lists by their existing headings without changing selection rules or copy destinations.

impact.text: Successful copies remain identical; their listing now precedes the exclusion warning. Because copying also moves, an exception during copying now prevents that warning from being reached.

source_notes.text: The root conversion entry was read. It establishes compile_model as artifact assembly, including auxiliary-file copying, rather than native-code compilation.

Issue #33, “Error converting model,” reports a tensor-file opening failure, later diagnosed in the discussion as too many open files, followed by a separate GLM inference discussion. Its relevance here is inferred solely from the matching compile_model traceback; the reordered auxiliary-file loop does not address that failure.

PR #25, “Language layers for Mistral Small 3.1 and InternVL3,” concerns language-only conversion and multimodal support. Shared conversion terminology is not evidence that it motivated this listing change.

limitations: No full conversion or filesystem copy was executed. The bounded check executed extracted listing code with a mocked copy operation and a mechanically reordered variant.

chapters.title: Separate copied files from exclusion warnings

claims.text: The unchanged filter skips directories, original safetensors, config.json and the original shard index. Files ending in .bin, .ckpt, .pth or .pt enter the warning list; other regular files enter the copy list. Only the first ten ignored filenames are displayed, followed by an omitted-count line when necessary.

A bounded check with tokenizer.json included and weights.bin ignored reproduced the old ambiguous ordering and the new separated ordering. Both variants requested the same input/tokenizer.json-to-output/tokenizer.json copy.
The change preserves print-before-copy behavior: a filename denotes an attempted copy, not proof of its completion. No new sorting, heading, exception handling or file-selection policy is introduced.

annotation.summary: Moves auxiliary-file copying before the exclusion warning so copied filenames no longer appear beneath an exclusion heading.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap,io,contextlib,types,os
s=Path('exllamav3/conversion/compile.py').read_text(); a=s.index('    if ignored_files:\n'); b=s.index('    # Write new model.safetensors.index.json',a); old=s[a:b]; k=old.index('    for f in filtered_files:'); new=old[k:]+old[:k]
for label,block in [('parent',old),('reordered',new)]:
 out=io.StringIO(); copies=[]
 env=dict(filtered_files=['tokenizer.json'],ignored_files=['weights.bin'],in_dir='input',out_dir='output',os=os,shutil=types.SimpleNamespace(copy=lambda a,b:copies.append((a,b))))
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):exec(textwrap.dedent(block),env)
 print(label,repr(out.getvalue()),copies)
